en: An old official postcard form printed in Estonian, filled in by hand in purple and black ink. The left side lists various telephone fees in a tabular format with columns for kroons and senti, while the right side has address lines, a serial number field, and handwritten recipient information. There are multiple postal and administrative stamps, including a circular postmark from Risti, Estonia. The paper is yellowed, indicating age.
